biggest_catch: You must set up a recurring payroll-type direct deposit totaling $500 or more in a calendar month within 60 days of opening — P2P transfers (Zelle), internal transfers, mobile deposits, and check deposits do not count.
catches: The qualifying direct deposit must be a recurring ACH of payroll, Social Security, unemployment, or pension totaling $500+ in a calendar month — one-time or non-payroll ACH, internal/external transfers, mobile deposits, cash/check deposits, and Zelle or other person-to-person payments do not qualify.
The $500+ direct deposit must land within 60 days of account opening.
Offer is only for members who do not already have a Cash Back Debit account and who have not closed their Affinity membership within the last 12 months.
Not available to Affinity FCU employees or its subsidiaries/affiliates/promotional agencies.
Membership is required (a $5 share in the Membership Eligibility Account must stay open and funded); this is a refundable deposit, not a fee.
The bonus is taxable income and may be reported to the IRS.
No monthly fee on the Cash Back Debit account when enrolled in eStatements; out-of-network ATM fee is $2.25.

steps: Join Affinity Federal Credit Union on the official site (membership required; keep the $5 membership share funded) — do not join from an affiliate link with different terms.
Open a new Affinity Cash Back Debit checking account (you must not already hold one, and must not have closed an Affinity membership in the last 12 months).
Enroll in eStatements to avoid the monthly fee.

Within 60 days of account opening, establish a recurring direct deposit of payroll, Social Security, unemployment, or pension totaling $500 or more in a calendar month. Do not rely on Zelle, Venmo/PayPal transfers, internal transfers, mobile deposits, or check deposits — they do not qualify.
The $100 bonus is deposited into your checking account by the last business day of the month after all criteria are complete.
timing: Application and account setup take 30–60 min active; then route a $500+/month recurring direct deposit within 60 days; bonus arrives by the last business day of the month after qualifying.
numeric_basis: payout from official terms ($100 flat); time: checking application + recurring DD setup est. 30-60 min active
